A time-saving initial note: buying bitcoins using this method will swallow up about 20% of your cash in transaction fees. Also, this isn't going to happen in 5 minutes but will take about a week in total to initially set up.

A lot of people can't fathom bitcoin out and more people yet don't want to start trading in the virtual currency, so here's a step by step guide on how to buy Bitcoins using Paypal.

Before I go on and people jump in here with "Use [this site]" - the most commonly suggested sites to set up quickly to obtain bitcoins are: Circle.com and Coinbase.com. However, if you're like me, you (a) are unable to use one of these sites because you are not US domiciled (Circle), (b) do not wish to send copies of your driving licence (c) do not wish to link your bank account to a bitcoin site.

You can also use Localbitcoin.com (same issues as above).

Before I get to the part about how you can buy bitcoins with paypal there's a couple of things you have to download and install on your computer - namely, Bitcoin wallet software.

I chose to use Armory having read a great many recommendations. Be warned, however, that once this software is installed it will begin downloading the entire internet transaction history for bitcoin and it is a monster download (around 40Gb) that will take a number of days to process.

Also, Armory will use every resource your computer has to process the Bitcoin Core for the first time.

Once you have done all of the above you can get to the buying stage.

So, here's how to BUY Bitcoins WITH Paypal.

Go to Virwox.com and create an account.

Deposit the amount of money you wish to exchange into bitcoins via the 'Deposit' link on the left.

Exchange your Deposit for your currency into SLL via the link on the left under 'Exchange'

(SLL is a Linden Dollar, which is part of the Second Life universe)

Once that's completed (only takes a minute), you then Exchange your SLL for BTC (Bitcoin), via the BTC/SLL link under 'Exchange' on the left.

When that entire process is completed, you will now be in possession of actual bitcoins.

Since you have already set up your Bitcoin wallet all you need do is Send Money from your Virwox account to your Bitcoin wallet.

There are transaction limits if using Paypal (you can use other payment options if you wish that do not carry the same limitations).

Love Banana Bread??? Try this recipe

Ingredients

6 large very ripe bananas (about 2¼ pounds), peeled (VERY RIPE-watch video)

1¾ cups (8¾ ounces) unbleached all-purpose flour

2 tsp granulated sugar

¾ cup (5¼ ounces) packed light brown sugar

1 tsp baking soda

½ tsp table salt

8 tbsp (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly

2 large eggs

1 tsp vanilla extract

½ cup walnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped

Instructions

  1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and set oven to 350 degrees. Spray 8½ by 4½-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. Whisk flour, salt, and baking soda together in large bowl.

  2. Place 5 bananas in microwave-safe bowl; cover with plastic wrap and cut several steam vents in plastic with paring knife. Microwave on high power until bananas are soft and have released liquid, about 5 minutes. Transfer bananas to fine-mesh strainer placed over medium bowl and allow to drain, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes (you should have ½ to ¾ cup liquid).

  3. Transfer liquid to medium saucepan and cook over medium-high heat until reduced to ¼ cup, about 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat, stir reduced liquid into bananas, and mash with potato masher until fairly smooth. Whisk in eggs, butter, brown sugar, and vanilla.

  4. Pour banana mixture into flour mixture and stir until just combined with some streaks of flour remaining. Gently fold in walnuts Scrape batter into prepared pan.

  5. Slice remaining banana diagonally into ¼-inch-thick slices. Shingle banana slices on top of either side of loaf, leaving 1½-inch-wide space down center to ensure even rise. Sprinkle granulated sugar evenly over loaf.

  6. Bake until toothpick inserted in center of loaf comes out clean, 55 to 75 minutes. Cool bread in pan on wire rack 15 minutes, then remove loaf from pan and continue to cool on wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.
